dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: Aye... In my many years spent sailing the open ocean, Captain Beidou took great delight in telling us many a tale of Rex Lapis' many feats.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: If Captain Beidou is the star that guides us in the night sky, then Rex Lapis is what keeps the whole sky up in place.

dialogues.speaker: Zhang Shun
dialogues.text: I always said that I would see a Rite of Descension if I returned to land. I never thought...
